ipe-rosa.note: Comércio's named landscape colour. Its only role (--role-commerce) is declared but not painted on the site; the site shows ipe-rosa-text only (its tint's role, --role-commerce-tint, lost its last use with the home's doors on 2026-11-12).

ipe-amarelo.note: Notícias' named landscape colour (2026-11-05). Its only role (--role-news) is declared but not painted on the site; the site shows ipe-amarelo-text only (its tint's role, --role-news-tint, lost its last use with the home's doors on 2026-11-12).

erva-mate.note: The Mapa's named landscape colour (2026-11-11), the green of the tereré. Its only role (--role-map) is declared but not painted on the site; the site shows erva-mate-text and erva-mate-tint (the Mapa's invitation, the one landscape tint the site paints).

map-city.note: The built city by day, a lighter clay; also the labels' halo. MapLibre reads no CSS: the map's paint stays plain colours.

map-green.note: Parks, woods and pitches by day: the clay with 15% of the groups' verde (#00875A), worked out into the palette because MapLibre reads no color-mix.

map-indigena.note: The Indigenous lands (the Reserva Indígena de Dourados) drawn as inhabited land, a little lighter than the ground: never the parks' green.

map-indigena-line.note: The Reserva's dashed edge by day: the soft ink at 45% on the clay, worked out into the palette.

display.purpose: The city's question on the home's sky ("O que está acontecendo em Dourados?"): three lines on phones (held to 9.5em), two from 760px (11.5em).

headline.displayName: Headline · the page on the sky
headline.purpose: The page's name on the sky; at 800 also the month's title and Comércio's letters.

next-title.purpose: The title of the home's next activity, its answer to the question: the one activity title set in Bricolage (The Two Voices Rule).

next-title-desk.purpose: The home's next activity's title from 1100px.

row-name.purpose: A page's name on the home's rows (Notícias, Mapa, Comércio), in the page's deep shade beside its 26px drawing.

statement.purpose: Who NOS follows ("O NOS acompanha o que 85 organizações de Dourados publicam"); the same 800 sets "Ver todas as N atividades" in Deep Urucum (1.3125rem/1.15, -0.02em; 1.5rem from 1100px).

date.purpose: Dates in NOS's voice, with tabular figures: the home's circled day ("sex 13/11"); the same 800 sets the map's counts (0.9375rem/1).

row-lead.purpose: What a page holds today, in ink on its home row: Notícias' lead headline, the Mapa's places, Comércio's businesses.

heading.purpose: The panel's day (tabular), the head of the calendar options and business names.

title.purpose: Day heads at 750 with tabular figures, and the home's "A próxima atividade" (1.2, -0.012em; 1.375rem from 1100px); 750 also for the information card's title, empty-state titles, the month's numerals, the Mapa's place names, "Camadas" and a place's "Treinos"; 700 for the Mapa invitation's heading.

activity-lead.purpose: An activity's title in the panel (Inter: the organization's own words).

activity.purpose: An activity's title on its card.

facts-desk.purpose: The home's next activity's facts from 1100px (1.0625rem/1.4 below), in the soft ink.

body.purpose: Reading text; descriptions at 0.9375rem/1.5; hints held to 34–36ch. On the home the rows' meta and the groups at 1rem, and the line under the question in Inter 500 and the sky's soft ink (1rem/1.45; 1.25rem/1.4 from 760px; 1.3125rem from 1100px).

meta.purpose: The organization and the place under an activity, in the soft ink; the time row above is 600 at 0.9375rem in ink.

button.purpose: Buttons (1.0625rem in the home's 52px pills); chips and segments 500 at 0.9375rem (600 chosen); tags and the phone bar 500 at 0.8125rem; month weekday heads 600 0.75rem 0.04em uppercase; the map's small print 0.6875rem, the smallest text.

shadows.name: day-rest
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 8%, transparent), 0 6px 16px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 7%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest by day: activity cards, the month, the desk panel, business and information cards, the message bubble.

shadows.name: night-rest
shadows.purpose: The same surfaces at night: no shadow, a 1px terra roxa line draws the edge (not `none`: lists add rings to it).

shadows.name: sheet-day
shadows.purpose: The bottom sheet over its scrim (the ink at 50%).

shadows.name: sheet-night
shadows.purpose: The only shadow at night: the bottom sheet over its scrim (Night Shade at 70%).

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: The quiet mark of selection, added to the rest shadow (the activity open in the panel) or inset (the month's chosen day).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The strong mark of focus: Deep Urucum by day, Night Urucum at night, the sky's ink on the sky.

shadows.name: pin-day
shadows.value: 0 0 0 2px var(--role-pin-ring), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 22%, transparent), 0 3px 8px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 16%, transparent)
shadows.variable: --role-pin-shadow (light), after the 2px ring in the card colour
shadows.purpose: The map's points and counts by day: tighter than the cards' rest, so they stand off the streets. A count puts its double ring (0 0 0 2.5px the ink, 0 0 0 5px the card colour) before it.

shadows.name: pin-night
shadows.variable: --role-pin-ring (dark); --role-pin-shadow (dark) is a 1px line the ring covers
shadows.purpose: The points at night: no shadow, the terra roxa ring alone draws the edge.

shadows.name: drop
shadows.purpose: The open place's drop on the map, by day.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The sheet's slide and the sun's rise.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour, border and shadow changes on hover and state: buttons, chips, segments, cards, the nav pill; the Mapa's layer chevron turns (rotate 180deg) in the same 0.15s.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: The bottom sheet slides up and away; while dragged it follows the finger with no transition; the Mapa's list sheet slides the same way.

motion.name: arrow-step
motion.purpose: The home's arrows ("Ver todas as N atividades" and each page's row) step 3px to the right on hover; never up, no lift. Instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: sun-rise
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: the home's sun rises a little when the page opens; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every transition and animation stops, and the Mapa's camera moves take no time (js/mapa.js passes 0; MapLibre drops its own zoom steps and pan inertia too).

motion.name: map-camera
motion.purpose: The Mapa's camera, only in answer to a tap: to a place (on phones to zoom 14.4 above its sheet; on the desk only when the place is under the rail or the card) or to the person's position ("Onde estou"). 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: map-fit
motion.purpose: A tap on a count fits its places. 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: map-zoom-step
motion.value: zoomIn / zoomOut, 500ms, the same ease (MapLibre's default)
motion.purpose: The map's zoom buttons (from 760px). 0 under prefers-reduced-motion (MapLibre's own check).

breakpoints.name: narrowest
breakpoints.purpose: 259px at 16px (zoomed phones): the send button drops its icon.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: 359px at 16px (small phones, 200% zoom, large default fonts): 12px gutters, a smaller page name, the home's question at 2.375rem and its next title at 1.75rem; the Mapa's "Como chegar" becomes a 48px circle.

breakpoints.name: wide-phone
breakpoints.purpose: 24px gutters; the bottom sheets centred at 560px (the Mapa's list and place too).

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: The links on the sky (no bar at the foot), the page's name or the home's question under them; the home's "Ver na agenda" beside "Mandar no WhatsApp", only its next title a link; Comércio's rows; the Mapa's map down to the screen's foot with its zoom buttons, its points 30px (26px below).

breakpoints.name: desk
breakpoints.purpose: Two columns: the agenda with its 380px panel, Comércio's information card; the home's next activity with its actions at the right and its three rows as columns, 48px apart; 32px gutters; the Mapa's 320px rail and 400px place card over the map.

breakpoints.name: desk-wide
breakpoints.purpose: The panel at 420px; the month writes its entries in.

breakpoints.name: short-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Panfleto scrolls its format bar to the top; the preview takes the title's room.

breakpoints.name: phone-landscape
breakpoints.value: max-width: 1099px and max-height: 500px and orientation: landscape
breakpoints.purpose: The sheet takes nearly the whole height; the flyer stands beside its controls.

breakpoints.name: short-desk
breakpoints.purpose: Flyer mode also folds the hint, so the preview keeps a useful size.

light.--role-card-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-earth-shadow) 8%, transparent), 0 6px 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-earth-shadow) 7%, transparent)
light.--role-pin-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-earth-shadow) 22%, transparent), 0 3px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-earth-shadow) 16%, transparent)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, in urucum: sending an activity to WhatsApp. Night Urucum with terra roxa text in the dark theme.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-accent" type="button"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.9 20A9 9 0 1 0 4 16.1L2 22Z"/></svg>Enviar no WhatsApp</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-accent, #C2410C); color: var(--role-on-accent, #FFFFFF); font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-accent .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--role-accent-hover, color-mix(in srgb, #C2410C 86%, #221714)); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: The second action beside the primary one: the card colour with a 1px line; done fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-line .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-btn-line:not(.is-done):hover { border-color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); background: var(--role-card-hover, #FFF4EC); } .ds-btn-line.is-done { border-color: var(--role-ink, #221714); background: var(--role-ink, #221714); color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Group Chips
components.description: The agenda's group filter: 36px pills (44px tap area), each group's dot before its name; pressed fills with ink and a check takes the dot's place.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 8px; } .ds-chip { position: relative; flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 36px; margin: 4px 0; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 500 0.9375rem/1 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chip::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -5px 0; } .ds-chip-check { display: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { padding-left: 10px; border-color: var(--role-ink, #221714); background: var(--role-ink, #221714); color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-chip-check { display: block; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-dot { display: none; } .ds-chip:not([aria-pressed="true"]):hover { background: var(--role-card-hover, #FFF4EC); border-color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dot { display: inline-block; flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sector, var(--role-no-sector, #6A4E44)); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Lista | Mês and Mensagem | Panfleto: two equal 42px segments in a pill; the chosen one in ink with a check in place of its icon.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; max-width: 420px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); } .ds-seg-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 500 1rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-seg-tab + .ds-seg-tab { border-left: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); } .ds-seg-tab .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-seg-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--role-ink, #221714); color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg-tab:not([aria-selected="true"]):hover { background: var(--role-card-hover, #FFF4EC); } .ds-seg-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-seg-tab[aria-selected="true"]:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Comércio's search: a 48px pill at 16px type (no iOS zoom), a soft icon inside, a round clear button; focus turns the line urucum.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; max-width: 400px; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; display: flex; color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-icon .ds-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; margin: 0; padding: 0 48px 0 46px; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 400 1rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:not(:placeholder-shown) { font-weight: 500; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--role-focus, #A3360A); } .ds-search-clear { position: absolute; right: 2px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--role-ink, #221714); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-clear .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-search-clear:hover { background: var(--role-wash, color-mix(in srgb, #221714 7%, transparent)); } .ds-search-clear:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation (phone bar)
components.description: Under 760px the five pages' links (Início, Agenda, Notícias, Mapa, Comércio) run along the foot of the screen; the open page in Deep Urucum, its icon in an Urucum Tint pill. From 760px they move onto the sky.
components.html: InícioAgendaNotíciasMapaComércio
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); max-width: 390px; padding: 6px 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 52px; border-radius: 12px; color: inherit; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.38 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-icon .ds-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--role-accent-text, #A3360A); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] .ds-nav-icon { background: var(--role-accent-tint, #F9D9C8); } .ds-nav-link:not([aria-current="page"]):hover .ds-nav-icon { background: var(--role-fill, #F4E4D9); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Activity Card

components.name: Início: the next activity and the rows
components.description: The home's land, set in type with no cards: "A próxima atividade", the day circled by the hand with "amanhã" in Deep Urucum, the title in Bricolage 800 (the one activity title in NOS's voice), the facts, the 52px "Mandar no WhatsApp" across the phone; "Ver todas as N atividades" in Deep Urucum; then the pages as rows between 1px clay-line rules, each name in its landscape colour's deep shade with its drawing and an arrow that steps 3px on hover, the Mapa's layers as 38px discs in the points' colours. The activity is the artboard's of 12/11 (no time or place yet); the rows show their texts before the sheets are read.

narrative.overview:
NOS opens on the sky over Dourados at this hour and the land beneath it. Every page stacks the same three layers: the header is the sky of this hour, painted in five flat bands (amanhecer, dia, entardecer and noite by the clock in the light theme, always the night in the dark theme); the woven band under it is the horizon; below lies the land, light clay by day and terra roxa at night, where the activities, the stories and the businesses rest as clear rounded cards (the home sets its land in type, without cards); on the Mapa the land is the city itself, drawn in the same clay and terra roxa. The sun, a disc inside an urucum loop drawn by hand, rises big from behind the band and runs off the edge; at night a small moon, about a fifth of the sun, sits high among the stars.

The hand is the system's signature. The same urucum pen that draws the sun's loop and the O of the NOS mark circles the next activity and underlines today: urucum is the one marking colour, and it marks rather than fills. Each page has one colour of the landscape, whose deep shade names it on the home and colours its icons (Agenda urucum, Notícias ipê-amarelo, Mapa erva-mate, Comércio ipê-rosa); the organizations' eight groups are coloured dots, and the Mapa's layers are drawings, never colours. Bricolage Grotesque is NOS's voice (the home's question, dates, page titles, day heads) and Inter the reading text and the controls. The density is calm and phone-first: lists of cards with 44px targets on the phone, a production bench on the desk, never a dashboard.

The world refuses the hero banner over icon tiles, the dashboard, the grey list with thin dividers and coloured pills, the marketplace (carousels, banners, prices, ratings), the stock web map (its own colours, coloured category pins, popups), and the Folhinha's notepad and torn-off sheets; nothing of the old campaign interface (the metro line to election day, the countdown, the slogan) comes back, and nothing should read as a startup, a city hall or an election campaign. Light and dark are both finished themes. The approved artboards (`design/direcao-ceu-terra-*.html`) also draw sections and a search that were deliberately not built; where they and the build diverge, the build is the reference. The flyers carry the same world into a picture: the sky of the activity's hour over the band and the land (see Components).
keyCharacteristics: Sky over land on every page, meeting at a woven horizon.
The sky in flat bands by the hour: hard stops, never a soft gradient.
One marking colour, urucum, drawn by hand: loops and strokes, not badges.
Pages in colours of the landscape; the organizations' groups as dots, the Mapa's layers as drawings.
Bricolage Grotesque 800 for the voice, Inter for reading; tabular dates.
Rounded cards and standard controls: pills, circles, 18px cards.
A soft earth-tinted shadow by day, a 1px line at night.
One authored motion: the home's sun rises.

rules.name: The One Marking Colour Rule
rules.body: Urucum marks; it never fills an area. At full strength it is only the hand (the loop around the next activity, the stroke under today, the sun's loop, the mark's O), the primary button, the open page and, on the Mapa, the person's own position; its tint may colour the phone bar's pill, selection, the error notice and that position's halo. If urucum covers a panel, a header or a card on the site, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Flat Sky Rule
rules.body: The sky is five flat bands with hard stops, coloured by the hour in the light theme and always the night in the dark theme: never a soft gradient, never a photo. Text on it uses only the sky's ink and soft ink, which hold 4.5:1 or more on every band of every hour (the lowest pair is 5.05:1, the dusk's soft ink); urucum on the sky is a drawn mark, never the only sign of a state.

rules.name: The Dots, Never Shapes Rule
rules.body: A group is a coloured dot (8px; 10px in the panel and on the home; 6px in the phone month), a thin bar in the phone month, or a tinted bar with its dot on the desk month: never a shape, an icon, a filled card or a coloured pill, and never the only place the group is named (the chips and the panel say it in words). A cancelled activity keeps its group's colour as an outline.

rules.name: The Plain Paint Rule
rules.body: MapLibre reads no CSS: the fourteen roles `js/map-style.js` reads (`--role-map-land` to `--role-map-indigena-line`) each resolve to a plain palette colour, never a `color-mix()`, so a mix the map needs is worked out into the palette (Map Green is the clay with 15% of verde, Map Indígena Line the soft ink at 45% on the clay). What the page draws over the map (the points, the drop, the small print's veil: `--role-pin-shadow`, `--role-pin-drop`, `--role-map-veil`) is CSS and mixes like the rest of the site.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque is NOS speaking: the home's question, dates, page titles, day heads, the headings that file things (the home's rows, letters, businesses, places) and the news headlines, which the team writes (750 on the cards, 800 for the lead and in the panel). Inter is what the organizations announce and every control: an activity's title is the organization's own words, set in Inter on its card, in the panel and on the flyers, and in a story what an organization said stays in Inter, attributed. The one exception is the home's next activity, typeset in Bricolage 800 as the answer to the city's question (Next Title; approved with the home on 2026-11-12): one activity, named as such, never a list or a card.

rules.name: The Tabular Dates Rule
rules.body: Every date, time and count is set with tabular figures, so days and hours line up down a list.

rules.name: The Planned Flyer Rule
rules.body: A flyer sets only the faces, weights and optical size its layout engine measured (`.impeccable/flyer-metrics.html`), and every line is planned before it is drawn: the preview and the PNG are one picture. Its numerals stand alone, so they keep the font's proportional figures; dates and times in lists keep the tabular ones. A new face or weight means measuring again.

rules.name: The Sky of the Hour Rule
rules.body: A flyer's sky is the hour its activity starts, never the hour it is made, and the day's when there is no time. Its text uses the sky's inks only, and the bands stay sky behind it: no edge crosses a line of text or comes within 20px of it (display type from 100px, which the bands must cross, only keeps its cap line, x-height and foot clear), every band is at least 40px tall, and they grow up from the horizon where the text lets them.

rules.name: The Horizon Rule
rules.body: Every page stacks the same three layers: the sky, the band (full-bleed; 16px under the inner pages' sky, 18px from 760px; 40px on the home, 44px from 760px), and the land. Nothing crosses the line: the land, the home's next activity included, starts under the band.

rules.name: The Sky Stays Rule
rules.body: (built 2026-11-06, waiting for the user's approval; artboards `design/topo-fixo-*.html`). The sky stays at the top of the screen, down to the band, while the land scrolls under it. Where the header is short (the inner pages on phones, 112px with the band) it stays whole. Where it is tall (from 760px, and the home) it folds: as the page leaves its top, the page's name and line (or the home's question and its line and, at night, the home's moon) fade out within the first 16px of scroll, and the header slides up under its bar (the mark, the links, the theme button), which stays, until only the bar is left with 22px of sky under it (so the links keep to the top band and the open page's stroke stays clear of the band's selvage), the last bands and the rising sun or the moon, over the band: 108px on the inner pages (180px at rest), 134px on the home with its thick band; on phones the home keeps only its bar over its band. The desk's panels stick under it, and whatever the keyboard or a link brings into view lands below it. Phones on their side (under 500px tall) keep their room: there the header scrolls away.

rules.name: The Calm Desk Rule
rules.body: The desk adds a column, never a dashboard: the agenda's list or month beside its panel, the home's next activity with its actions at its right and its three pages as columns, the Mapa's map between its rail and its place card, Comércio's list beside its information card.

rules.name: The Day Shadow, Night Line Rule
rules.body: Cards rest on the earth shadow by day and on a 1px line at night: never a shadow on the land in the dark theme, never a hard offset shadow, never a lift on hover.

rules.name: The Quiet Selection Rule
rules.body: Selection is a 1.5px soft-ink ring; focus is the strong 2px urucum ring (the sky's ink on the sky). They never trade places, and a selected card that takes focus shows both.

rules.name: The Hand Rule
rules.body: The only freehand forms are the hand's: two open pen loops (two drawings, so they don't look stamped) and a short underline on the land, in urucum at 2.5px (3px around the home's circled day) with round caps that keep their width as they stretch to what they mark; the astro's loop on the sky, whose pen grows with the sun (3px to 6px); and the O of the mark. A loop circles only the next activity, the underline only today; never a perfect ring or a badge in their place.

rules.name: The Pills and Cards Rule
rules.body: Controls are pills or circles and containers are 18px cards (the sheet 24px at its top); no button, field or card on the land has sharp corners, except the day cells inside the month's grid.

rules.name: The Real Band Rule
rules.body: The provisional band may only be replaced by the real one: made, signed and paid for by artists of the Reserva Indígena de Dourados (Kaiowá, Guarani Ñandeva and Terena), with their visible credit in place of the provisional one. Never imitate or adapt anyone's grafismo in the meantime, and never draw a new "Indigenous" pattern to fill the band.

rules.name: The Landscape Shade Rule
rules.body: On the land a page's colour of the landscape is its deep shade: its name, drawing and arrow on the home's row, its icons on its own page (Comércio's information card). The one fill is the Mapa's invitation to send a missing place ("Falta algum lugar?", in its panel, shown only once `MAP_SUGGEST_URL` has a link): a 12px block in the Erva-Mate Tint with its icon in the deep shade and its heading in Bricolage 700. Nothing else on a page takes a tint of its colour.

rules.name: The Inhabited Land Rule
rules.body: The tiles carry the Indigenous lands as nature reserves; the map draws them as inhabited land. The Reserva Indígena de Dourados (the Jaguapiru and Bororó villages, home to Kaiowá, Guarani Ñandeva and Terena people) is a land a little lighter than the ground, edged by a dashed line in the soft ink, with its name in the strong label: never the parks' green.

dos: Do take every colour from a role (`--role-*` in `css/theme.css`); the only literals in the stylesheets are `transparent`, `currentColor`, the band's image and system colours under forced colours.
Do paint the map only through its `--role-map-*` paint roles, each a plain palette colour (The Plain Paint Rule).
Do finish every new surface in both themes and under all four skies, with any text on the sky in the sky's ink or soft ink (4.5:1 or more on every band).

Do keep urucum for the hand, the primary button, the open page and the person's position on the map; give a new page its own colour of the landscape, its deep shade naming it on the home's row and colouring its icons (Comércio ipê-rosa, Notícias ipê-amarelo, Mapa erva-mate; The Landscape Shade Rule).
Do show a group as its dot beside its name, so colour is never the only carrier of meaning.
Do circle the next activity and underline today with the hand marks, and nothing else on the site; on a flyer the hand circles the activity's date or day and strikes out what was cancelled.
Do set dates in Bricolage 800 with tabular figures, headings at 700–750, and what the organizations announce in Inter (the home's next activity aside: The Two Voices Rule).
Do rest cards on the day shadow and the night line from the roles, and mark selection with the quiet soft-ink ring.
Do keep every target at 44px or more (the 36px chips carry a 44px tap area, and every point, pair and count on the map a 44px tap circle) and size text in rem.
Do credit the band as provisional in every footer while `assets/faixa.svg` is the provisional art.
donts: Don't fill a panel, a header or a card with full-strength urucum on the site, or use it for anything but marking.
Don't draw the sky with a soft gradient, a photo or a texture, or set text on it in anything but the sky's inks.
Don't give the groups shapes, icons, filled cards or coloured pills, and don't colour Comércio's categories or the Mapa's layers: a layer is its drawing on an ink point.
Don't replace the band with an imitation or adaptation of any people's grafismo; the real band comes from artists of the Reserva Indígena de Dourados, signed, paid and credited.
Don't put shadows on the land in the dark theme, use hard offset shadows, or lift elements on hover.
Don't use the strong urucum ring for selection or the quiet ring for focus.
Don't fetch fonts from Google Fonts, or set an activity's title in Bricolage on a card, in the panel or on a flyer (the home's next activity is the one exception).

Don't add motion beyond the home's rising sun (1.6s, off under reduced motion); state changes are 0.15s colour transitions, the sheet's 0.3s slide and, on the home, its arrows' 3px step to the right on hover (0.2s; instant under reduced motion). The header's fold is not motion of its own: it is the scroll, and the page's name (the home's question) fades over the first 16px of it, under reduced motion too. The Mapa's camera is the one exception, and it only answers a tap: it eases in 700ms to a place or to the person's position and fits a count's places in 600ms (MapLibre's own zoom buttons step in 500ms), all instant under reduced motion; its list's chevron turns in the same 0.15s as a state change.

Don't bring the Folhinha's devices to the site (the red header card, bindings, perforations, a yellow "Próxima") or the old campaign interface (the metro line to election day, the countdown, the slogan); nothing should read as a startup, a city hall or an election campaign.
Don't invent logos, photos, slogans, ratings or prices for the organizations or the businesses.
Don't bring the stock web map to the Mapa (its own colours, coloured category pins, popups), or draw the Indigenous lands as parks (The Inhabited Land Rule).
